description: Investigate the codebase and produce a concrete plan before any change is made. Read-only: изучает код и составляет план, ничего не меняя.

nodes.instruction:
Task: {{task}}
Read the relevant files and write a concrete change plan: what to change, in which files, in which order, how to verify it. Do NOT modify anything. When the plan is complete answer with the JSON object: plan_ready=true and plan=<the plan as text>.
